ValidationRule.description: Required for conversion: Address in valid location, Appointment Date and Time, Expected Attendees
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( IsConverted = true, OR( ISBLANK( TEXT(Location__c) ), ISBLANK( Appointment_Date_Time__c ), ISBLANK( TEXT( Expected_Attendees__c ) ) ), AND( NOT(ISNEW()) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Required for conversion: Address in valid location, Appointment Date and Time, Expected Attendees
